jobs.title: Physics Tutor in Tulsa
jobs.description:
BuffTutor is a network of experienced and passionate tutors who provide academic assistance to college & high school students. We are always hiring dedicated tutors; if you love teaching, join us!
RESPONSIBILITIES:

•
Provide 1-on-1 in-person tutoring to students attending universities or high schools in Tulsa such as University of Tulsa.

•
Provide online tutoring to students located throughout the country (if desired).

•
Assist students with Physics topics

• Classical mechanics: Kinematics, dynamics, forces, momentum, energy
,• Thermodynamics: Heat, temperature, ideal gases, laws of thermodynamics
,• Electricity and magnetism: Charges, fields, potential, circuits, induction
,• Waves and optics: Wave characteristics, sound, geometric/physical optics
,• Relativity and modern physics: Time dilation, length contraction, quantum basics
,• Nuclear physics: Radioactivity, fission, fusion, and atomic structures

BENEFITS:
• Set your own rate.
• In-person & online tutoring available; meet wherever works for you.
• Set your own schedule; meet whenever works for you.
• Work with as many (or as few) students as you would like to.

QUALIFICATIONS:
• Have at least a 3.0 or better major GPA (out of 4.0).
• Have earned a B or better in the courses you wish to tutor.
• Have at least one year (or two semesters) of experience as a tutor, teacher, teaching/learning assistant or instructor.
• Have excellent communication skills and you must be fluent in the language that you teach in. Foreign Language tutors must be fluent in the Foreign Language they wish to tutor.

ABOUT BUFFTUTOR:
BuffTutor is dedicated to connecting students with intelligent and experienced tutors. We primarily focus on university level tutoring, but also work with high school and middle school students. More than just another tutor list, we prioritize the academic needs of our students while also treating our tutors with dignity and respect:
• We have some of the strictest eligibility criteria and challenging proficiency exams. Only the best can join our network!
• Tutors can set their own schedule. Our motto is quality is more important than quantity. Take on one student but be the best tutor for that student!
• Tutors can set their own rate. Earn what you are worth!
• We review student evaluations to help us keep the best tutor in our network.
BuffTutor was founded in 2009 and since then we have helped thousands of students and parents connect with affordable and passionate educators!
Please note that tutors are independent contractors, not employees. All applicants must already have work permissions; applicants who are students must be able to work an off-campus position. We do not sponsor individuals and we cannot work with F-1 or J-1 international students

jobs.description:

Location

US/Remote (EST preferred)

Employment Type

Contract (1–2 Years, Special Project)

Pay Rate

$55.00 – $60.00/hour (Up to $75.00/hour for candidates with extensive, highly relevant utility experience)

Schedule

Standard Business Hours

Target Start Date

ASAP

About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented Data Analyst / Data Scientist to join our Customer Analytics and Digital Products team on a high-impact, special project. In this role, you will analyze large-scale utility datasets, evaluate customer-facing digital products (such as rate recommendation and bill comparison tools), and build interactive reporting tools to drive business decisions and improve customer experience.

Data Analysis & Quality Control:

Analyze large utility datasets—including AMI usage, Customer Care & Billing (CC&B), and customer engagement data—to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and quality issues.

Visualization & Reporting:

Design and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and visual summaries to track product performance, billing outcomes, and key customer metrics.

Digital Product Support

Support customer-facing digital products (e.g., rate recommendation tools and bill comparison features) using historical usage and billing data.

Engagement Analytics

Track and analyze website and digital engagement metrics (such as page views, clicks, and user interactions).

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

Partner closely with Product Owners, software engineers, and business SMEs to support data integrations, user testing, and product enhancements.

Stakeholder Communication

Translate complex technical findings into actionable insights and present recommendations clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.

Required Qualifications & Skills

Utility Industry & AMI Data (MUST-HAVE):

Direct experience working with Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) and utility customer usage data. Note: Candidates without utility/AMI experience will not be considered.

Professional Experience

2+ years of professional data analysis experience, with a proven track record of reviewing large data extracts/dumps to identify trends and data anomalies.

Technical Proficiency

Hands-on experience with Power BI for dashboard creation and data visualization.

Experience with Databricks or working with large, multi-source datasets.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.

Core Competencies

Strong data validation and problem-solving skills, extreme attention to detail, and excellent verbal and written communication skills suitable for a regulated environment.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills

Experience with Customer Care & Billing (CC&B)

data and tools.

Proficiency with Google Analytics or other web/digital engagement tracking platforms.

Proven track record developing recurring customer analytics reports and tracking digital product adoption.

jobs.title: Contract and Data Analyst - Managed Care
jobs.description:
SpringPoint Technologies is recruiting a Contract & Data Analyst for a healthcare organization in Tulsa. This position supports managed care contracting through financial analysis, reimbursement modeling, and payment compliance reviews across hospital and physician services.

The analyst will evaluate existing and proposed payer contracts, develop reimbursement projections, and provide insights that support negotiations and improve financial performance.

Responsibilities
• Analyze managed care contract terms and communicate their financial and operational impact.
• Develop financial models and reimbursement projections for existing and proposed payer contracts.
• Build, maintain, and test contract projection models in Epic.
• Evaluate contract performance and compare actual payer payments against expected reimbursement.
• Investigate underpayments and payment discrepancies; collaborate with internal teams and payers to resolve issues.
• Support payer negotiations through rate analysis, financial projections, and contract recommendations.
• Maintain accurate datasets and prepare reports on reimbursement trends and contract performance.
• Collaborate with managed care, finance, revenue cycle, and Epic application teams.

Qualifications
• Completed bachelor’s degree in business or a related field required.
• Healthcare industry experience required.
• Approximately 3–4 years of relevant experience in payer contracting, reimbursement analysis, or healthcare financial modeling preferred.
• Strong analytical skills and proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
• Ability to interpret contract terms, investigate discrepancies, and communicate findings clearly.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.

Preferred Experience
• Provider fee schedules, contract rate analysis, or expected reimbursement calculations.
• Hospital or physician billing and reimbursement.
• Epic, particularly reimbursement contract configuration or modeling.
• Microsoft Access, Power BI, or SQL.
• Existing Epic certification is not required at hire. The selected candidate must be willing to obtain and maintain assigned Epic certification.

How to Apply

Submit your current resume for consideration.

jobs.title: Senior LabVIEW Engineer – Test Systems & Automation
jobs.description:
Description

Agile Space Industries is a rapidly growing supplier of propulsion hardware and engineering services for the space industry. Headquartered in Durango, Colorado, with expanding operations in and Tulsa, Oklahoma, and upcoming growth in Seattle, Washington, Agile has achieved more than 40% year-over-year growth for the past three years, and our momentum continues to accelerate.

At Agile, we design, build, and test in-space propulsion systems that give spacecraft the ability to maneuver with precision, reliability, and purpose. Our technologies play a critical role in missions that range from lunar landings and resource utilization to national defense, human exploration, and commercial space transport.

We are seeking bold and driven individuals who thrive in a hands-on, fast-moving environment and want to help write the next chapter of space history as part of a close-knit, innovative team. You will take on a demanding and rewarding role at Agile, directly shaping the future of in-space propulsion. As an integral contributor during our growth stage, you will be eligible to participate in our stock option plan, giving you the opportunity to share in the long-term value you help create. All stock grants are subject to executive review and approval in accordance with the Company’s equity plan.

Agile Space Industries is seeking an experienced onsite Data Acquisition and Controls Systems (DACS) LabVIEW Engineer in Tulsa, OK to provide technical experience and depth to our DACS team supporting hypergolic propulsion systems testing. The ideal candidate for this role will have technical experience to provide guidance to other DACS engineers and program teams, to make informed architecture decisions, and guide the development process while working as a team member on active development projects. Critical skillsets include systems design and development, LabVIEW development, project and team leadership skills, and technical decision making with a focus on safety and reliability. This position requires a leadership and collaboration mindset with a focus on pragmatic and timely implementation.

This position is onsite and may be based in either Tulsa, Oklahoma or Durango, Colorado.

Responsibilities
• Support the Agile Test Site Operations team by designing, developing, testing, integrating, troubleshooting, and upgrading software used in propulsion testing
• Work in NI LabVIEW, including LabVIEW FPGA and LabVIEW Real-Time, to create and maintain control and measurement applications
• Work with sensors including but not limited to pressure transducers, thermocouples, RTDs, strain gauges, accelerometers, pyrometers, and flow meters
• Work with control mechanisms including but not limited to pneumatic solenoid valves, remote pressure regulators, relays, valve drivers, VFDs, motorized throttling valves
• Ensure compliance with applicable software development standards and best practices
• Interface with various test and measurement instruments such as power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes
• Implement and support communication protocols including VISA, TCP/IP, and serial interfaces
• All work shall be performed in a collaborative team environment with a focus on safety and long-term system reliability

Requirements
• You will be required to work on-site at our testing facilities located in Durango, CO
• Education: B.S. or advanced degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related engineering field (with strong programming background)
• 8+ Years relevant experience
• 5+ Years experience with LabVIEW (Actor Framework preferred)
• Demonstrated expertise in programming languages such as Python or C++
• Demonstrated expertise in the fundamentals of object-oriented programming
• Hands-on experience designing and debugging low voltage electrical systems
• Experience working within Linux-based environments

jobs.title: Technical Lead, Customer Delivery (Applied AI/Physics)
jobs.description:
Lead Delivery Engineer at a leading Physics AI / Simulation Startup - Aerospace/Defense/Automotive

You sit at the cutting edge of Physics AI, working directly with customers to solve hard engineering problems that actually matter.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role at a fast-growing Series B startup. You are not buried in an internal team waiting months to see whether your work made a difference. You are in front of customers, understanding their problems, building solutions, and seeing the impact almost immediately. The feedback loop is tight and the visibility is real.

The company is pushing the frontier of Physics AI, and the customers reflect that ambition. You work across scaling startups and F100 enterprises, applying simulation and AI-driven physics capabilities to some of the most complex engineering challenges in the world. Experience with PINNs, surrogate models, physics-informed ML, or similar will stand out.

Day to day you are leading technical delivery, engaging directly with customer teams, and drawing on deep multiphysics knowledge. You bring that fluency into the room and translate it into solutions that work for the people in front of you.

To thrive here you bring solid experience in at least one of the following segments: aerospace, defense, automotive, industrial, or semiconductor. You have multiphysics simulation fluency across multiple disciplines. You have led technical work before and you are comfortable engaging with customers or non-technical stakeholders, translating complexity into clarity.

This company cannot provide visa sponsorship. Candidates must be eligible to work in the US as a citizen or green card holder.

Base salary will be competitive, plus meaningful equity and full benefits. Relocation support can be available.

If this sounds like you, apply now.
